records.c: The last 144 character cells of the stages 4–5 status template. $A803 copies them with the preceding 16 cells at resident $2BF0–$2BFF to $3720–$37BF. The template contains endurance graphics, labels and initial numeric text; live values overwrite the lives, score, stage and timer cells.
Forty-eight retained screen-code spaces ($20) after the copied status template and before the colour table. The bounded status copy ends at $2C8F; no broader use is inferred from the repeated bytes.

Colour-RAM values indexed by character code for stages 4–5. The column renderer $2B14 reads one for each character written to the playfield; the colour chip keeps only the low nibble, whose bit 3 selects multicolour for a cell when the screen enables it.
